requirements.text: Preserve authentic SKU physical appearance, upholstery colour, quilting, seams, and physical product branding without alteration or artificial label removal.
Prohibit synthetic photographic manipulation including added white patches, contrast fades, artificial haze, blur masks, and digital gradients inside photographic scenes.
Restate strategic intentions without asserting unverified medical, cortisol reduction, orthopedic cure, or quantified airflow claims without product-specific approved substantiation.

preferences.text: Support unchanged product finishes with a warm restorative palette comprising bone, sand, taupe, stone, sage, olive, clay, wine, midnight blue, and soft sky.
Use a clear, motivated primary light source with believable practical lamps, defining morning reset, quiet day, and evening exhale modes without applying uniform warm casts.
Feature grounded, tactile architectural materials like textured plaster, limewash, warm wood, matte stone, cane, linen, and integrated architectural greenery over polished or synthetic surfaces.
Select breathable, lived-in, matte apparel such as washed cotton, linen, and soft jersey in muted tones that naturally show body contact and posture release.
Keep high-urgency promotional graphics, discount countdowns, and commercial badges distinct from domestic restorative room photography.

visualRules.value: Red is strictly an intentional brand punctuation cue (logo, CTA, product tag, thin accent line, single object); do not flood rooms with red bedding, red curtains, red walls, or red outfits.
Retouching must preserve authentic fabric weave, skin truth, natural daylight variations, and shadows; never apply plastic skin smoothing, artificial glows, fake blur, or oversaturated red.

Depict authentic rest and recovery through soft hands, closed eyes, real stretching, reading, or quiet companionship; prohibit thumbs-up gestures, pointing, presenter poses, camera stares, and exaggerated smiles.
Maintain a clean sans-serif type hierarchy where headlines have breathing space and supporting proof points follow an orderly structure without crowded badges or typographic clutter.
Position the hero product with 25% to 40% negative breathing space using genuine architectural wall and floor planes rather than artificial canvas margins.

preserve: Authentic physical product appearance, fabric weave, construction details, and existing product branding labels.
Strategic core essence of 'Motivating Reset' supported by an attentive, insightful, supportive, and warm brand tone.
Official public logo mark (solid symbol and uppercase DUROFLEX) pending validated production vector updates.
Client scene boundary requiring genuine architectural negative space rather than synthetic post-production fades.
explore: Spatial layouts derived from domestic archetypes (Compact connected home, Garden-threshold reset, Warm social lounge, Sheltered reading corner).
Structured multi-asset capture suites (Icon silhouette, Inhabited Hero, World environment, and verified Intelligence details).
Narrative arcs illustrating transition from fatigue to stillness, restoration, and renewed everyday participation.
Restrained category-specific accents (crisp daylight for sleep, deeper evening warmth for motion sofas) built around unchanged furniture.
avoid: Artificial photographic overlays, digital contrast fades, fake haze, white patches, and blur masks.
Performative ad gestures including direct camera staring, pointing, thumbs-up signs, and forced showroom grins.
Flooding room sets with excessive red décor, red walls, red bedding, or fully red apparel.
Medical theatre tropes, anatomical red glows, clinical staging, or unverified physiological cure claims.
Retouching out authentic physical brand labels present on manufactured SKUs.
unknowns: Formal enterprise adoption and rollout status of proposed portfolio sub-brand architecture (Restore, Recharge, Oasis, Recalibrate).
Resolution of typography and logo master vectors between public uppercase brand identity and draft guide serif renderings.
Specific independent clinical substantiation for quantified product claims (e.g., airflow percentages, stress-relief metrics).
Exact mechanical clearance and operating dimension specifications for individual motion and smart sleep models.
guide.decisionSummary: Execution guidance grounds Duroflex in its strategic evolution ('Designed to De-Stress' and 'Motivating Reset') while enforcing photographic integrity. Physical product truthfulness and authentic branding remain protected by forbidding artificial gradient fades, fake white patches, or digital label removal. The 151-slide visual guide is treated as a draft framework: its spatial archetypes and controlled-red rules serve as strong creative guardrails, while promotional urgency is strictly isolated from authentic restorative home photography.
